image_assets.slot: Home hero static visual / video poster candidate
image_assets.visual_intent: Editorial proposal: realistic small-business planning meeting; anonymous collaborative participants review a neutral website wireframe or written project outline on a desk. People depicted are generic models, not BGI Solutions staff or clients.
image_assets.generation_prompt: Ultra-realistic editorial photograph for a premium but approachable business consulting and website production website. A small diverse group of adult business professionals in a contemporary, neutral workspace quietly reviewing blank website wireframes, notes and a laptop. Natural window light, genuine candid posture, precise materials, credible small-business scale. Keep the left 45 percent visually quiet for separate live headline and buttons; activity to the right. Restrained slate-blue and warm-neutral palette, premium sharpness, believable photographic texture, 24 mm environmental perspective. No legible writing, logo, claimed location, awards or metrics. People are conceptual models, not actual BGI personnel or customers.
image_assets.negative_prompt: No fake BGI branded shirts, no recognizable company logos, no fabricated testimonials or charts, no legible AI text, no oversaturated stock-photo posing, no distorted hands or computer interfaces, no invented US office identity.
image_assets.alt_text_proposal: Illustrative business planning discussion around a website project.
image_assets.responsive_composition: 21:9 desktop with 4:5 mobile crop or dedicated variant; keep content readable without image.
image_assets.required_fallback: Page remains complete with live text when absent

image_assets.slot: Home service map / illustrative deliverables preview
image_assets.visual_intent: Editorial proposal: clear compositional preview of unbranded, illustrative website and business-research materials; precise family labels must be live HTML or SVG, not baked into this image.
image_assets.generation_prompt: Photorealistic premium desktop still life showing a generic tablet or laptop with clean blank website sections, a simple printed roadmap, customer interview notes without legible text, and restrained blue-grey stationery. Emphasize actual materials and thoughtful content production rather than invented dashboards. Medium-angle composition with balanced negative space and realistic paper texture. A conceptual business service visual for BGI Solutions; no claims of completed client work.
image_assets.negative_prompt: No real client logos, no analytics results, no exact chart labels, no fake generated text, no clutter, no unrealistic device screens, no unlicensed third-party UI.
image_assets.alt_text_proposal: Illustrative website planning and business research materials.
image_assets.responsive_composition: 4:3 desktop and 4:5 mobile, crop subject centrally; add service family names only as accessible live text.
image_assets.required_fallback: Page remains complete with live text when absent

image_assets.slot: SVC-01 illustrative constraint diagnosis visual
image_assets.visual_intent: Editorial proposal: conceptual assessment work surface; precise symptom, evidence and causal labels must be rendered as HTML/SVG outside generated image.
image_assets.generation_prompt: Ultra-realistic close editorial scene of a consultant reviewing a neutral business process sketch beside printed notes, sticky notes without legible words, and a simple empty relationship-map template. Subtle visual separation of possible symptoms, evidence and causes without numerical results or presented conclusions. Modern understated professional workspace, natural soft daylight, crisp texture, slate-blue and warm-paper palette. Right-weighted or centered practical composition that remains clear as a crop, with space for live overlaid HTML labels if needed.

image_assets.alt_text_proposal: Illustrative materials arranged for a business growth assessment.
image_assets.responsive_composition: 16:9 desktop, 4:5 mobile crop; build any functional constraint map as live accessible HTML/SVG.

Editorial library grouped by topic, source, author and date; stage empty article destinations.
Business narrative, actual founder/team details when provided, and authentic rights-cleared photographs only.
Short labeled form next to practical next-step explanation; disable submission until verified routing and privacy.
Four-question decision comparison with independent service modules; stack comparison cards on mobile.
Research-area index, clear evidence flow and four service modules; readable labels as HTML/SVG.
Distinct customer-discovery-to-decision journey and seven standalone service options; no mandatory sequence.
Split customer-lifecycle map and website/materials gallery; distinguish customer programs from SVC-18 production.
Two-path decision map separating AI readiness from ongoing optimization; avoid implying deployments.

build_validation_rules: Each image ID maps to exactly one route unless explicitly authorized as a reusable asset.
Do not treat proposed paths or generated prompts as evidence of existing files.
Check real files and exact filename casing before build; verify served URL, media type and response.
Provide fallback HTML and alt text; test mobile crop and lazy/eager loading.
For Home hero_video validate playable formats, poster, pause and prefers-reduced-motion behavior.
Do not publish work examples, staff likenesses, testimonials, certification icons or business results without verified consent and evidence.
